## **I Switched My Website to Quarto**

After a long time using a Jekyll + Bootstrap setup, I finally migrated my website to **Quarto**! Updating my old site had become pretty cumbersome. Every small change required tweaking templates and rebuilding pages manually.

Since I’ve already been using **Quarto** for my notes, project documentation, and even writing manuscripts, switching my website to the same framework was pretty easy.
